info.title: SHADOWCHAIN AI
info.description: SHADOWCHAIN API contract v1. Authenticated tenant-scoped graph intelligence, durable six-agent workflows and replayable persisted events. Findings are potential attack paths. AWS is optional and disabled by default; no IAM execution exists.

get.description: Process liveness; deliberately independent of downstream availability.
Readiness requires a successful Cypher query against the configured FalkorDB graph.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.default: The graph model is first observed potentially reachable at this sampled source time. Event provenance identifies modeled changes; temporal correlation does not prove real-world causality or exploitable AWS authorization. Simultaneous events are grouped.

x-websocket-contract.delivery: Replayable at-least-once; persist last processed cursor client-side
